input.command: cd <RUN_ROOT>/repo && PY=<PY>; T=../.tmp/probe; rm -rf "$T"; mkdir -p "$T"; printf '[1,2]' > "$T/list.json"; $PY scripts/review_evidence.py validate --pack "$T/list.json" --schema "$T/list.json" > "$T/out.json" 2>"$T/err.txt"; echo "EXIT=$?"; $PY -c "import json;d=json.load(open('$T/out.json'));print('KEYS',sorted(d));print('VIOL',d['violations']);print('VERSIONS',d['contract']['supportedSchemaVersions'])"; echo "STDERR_BYTES=$(wc -c < $T/err.txt)"; rm -rf "$T"
